actor_occupancy_gt.purpose: LiDAR occupancy and camera-LiDAR fusion evaluation

class_notes.standing_object: Observed as tunnel frames, guardrails, poles, and other permanent roadside structures; keep as background, not transient actor ignore.
class_notes.obstacle: Observed on spawned cones and hazard/fire props; exclude from drivable supervision and include in actor occupancy GT.
class_notes.ego_vehicle: Fixed visible ego hood/body is non-road background; do not discard a large fixed image region with actor ignore.
class_notes.instance: All audited Semantic actor pixels had nonzero Instance values; Instance is retained for future identity-aware evaluation but v2 binary masks are derived from Semantic classes.

palette_source: MORAI 26.R1 Semantic camera official RGB palette encoded in data_collection.mask_baker.OFFICIAL_PALETTE_RGB
